args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The nightly build showed tests/test_money.py expecting banker's
rounding while src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN to implement the documented behavior.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `round_money` using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` when quantizing to cents, matching the existing docstring/documentation (FIN-212).
- No test changes needed; the existing tests now pass.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (https://example.com/ci/ci-0001).

## Example
- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")` ✓
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` ✓ (banker's rounding)
